sloka: रथानश्वान् द्रुमैः शैलैस्ते प्रचिक्षिपुराहवे।शरौधैः प्रतिचिच्छेद तान् यूपाक्षो निशाचरः ।। ६.७६.१९ ।।
transliteration: rathānaśvān drumaiḥ śailaiste pracikṣipurāhave।śaraudhaiḥ praticiccheda tān yūpākṣo niśācaraḥ ।। 6.76.19 ।।

translations.english: In that war the Vanaras hurled trees, rocks on chariots and horses and Yupaksha encountered them and tore them.
